notes:
Context: Orchid builds behavioral personalization for display and email. Needed a reranker and embeddings store integrated into their feature pipeline. POC interest was high, technical fit good. Pricing: they had a strict procurement ceiling and preferred vendor that bundled managed on-prem agent with bring-your-own-model (BYOM) flexibility. 

Calls / quotes: 
- "We like Redwood's observability but the math on committed GPUs doesn't land for our CFO." 
- "Fireworks offered an on-prem agent + Replicate licensing that matches our ops model — less upfront reserve." 

Root causes for loss: 
- Competitor bundled approach reduced procurement friction (single vendor + lower first-year spend). 
- No internal champion after Data Platform lead left during vendor evaluation — stalled internal approvals. 
- Security requested default retention policy change; team estimated 3 months to certify which procurement saw as a cost/time risk. 

Action items (internal): 
- Capture POC telemetry and cost model used in their evaluation (attached). 
- Work with pricing to design a phased reserved-capacity offering for mid-market with lower entry commitment. 
- Share HLD with Product for tighter SSO + retention default docs to shorten security certification time.
